unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a governed policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths to keep production agents auditable and controllable.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing usage-based subscription forecasting with partner deal support to expand recurring enterprise engagement.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry instrumentation, and rollback controls across production agent execution.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design.
- bul_unify_005: Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines and dense-sparse retrieval design across cloud-native execution layers.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke client delivery into reusable AI platform IP through an operating model built for agentic platform commercialization.
